verses.1: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
verses.2: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
verses.3: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
